name: statute_lookup
description: Exact text of one provision of the CGST Act or CGST Rules. Use when you know the section or rule number.

name: statute_search
description: Search the CGST Act and Rules by meaning when you do not know the provision number.

flat.description: ablation only: plain chunks without section context

name: limitation_check
description: Last lawful dates for the show cause notice and the order under s.73 or s.74 for one financial year, and whether the given dates are in time. Marks the answer contested when it depends on the s.168A extension notifications.

name: date_diff
description: Number of days from start to end (negative if end is earlier).

name: caselaw_search
description: Search High Court GST judgments (precedent collection only) for how courts have treated a procedural point. Use for points where courts may disagree.

name: record_lookup
description: Read one field of this proceeding's record, as a dotted path, e.g. "notices.0.hearing_date", "order.date", "events".

name: send_reply
description: Send a reply to the tax officer. Never call this without explicit human approval; it only writes to a sandbox.
